title: Service contract for technical support for an EU platform on coexistence between people and large carnivores.
description: The contractor will be required to carry out the following tasks:Task A — support to the work of the platformCompilation of relevant documents and good practices:The contractor will assist the members of the platform to identify and collect examples of good practices of reduction and/or avoidance of conflicts and experiences of situations in which people successfully coexist with large carnivores.Assistance with the communication plan of the platform:The contractor will assist the Commission and the members of the platform to elaborate a draft communication plan for the platform, to be transmitted through the network of the membership on the umbrella stakeholder groups who make up the platform.The contractor will draft and prepare the lay-out for a 4-page flyer containing up-to-date information on the platform, in all official EU languages apart from Maltese and Irish. The flyers will be printed by the European Commission.Task B — the resource centre of the platformThe resource centre of the platform is a Web-based resource centre which does not duplicate other available resources but will provide links to those in addition to storing unique information, or information not elsewhere available digitally (subject to copyright restrictions).The contractor will update and subsequently maintain the website, exclusively using the technologies under which the site is developed (only static HTML pages), on large carnivores developed as part of the nature web pages of DG ENV.Frequently asked questions (FAQ) service:The contractor will maintain a FAQ section on the website for questions concerning best practice and advice on human–large carnivore conflicts.Regular e-mail circular:The contractor will draft a monthly e-mail bulletin to the members of the platform with news on recent developments of the internal work of the platform, and requests for information and input from the members of the platform. Elements from this circular may also be posted on the bi-monthly updates of the website.
